cases.name: front
cases.strategy: Remain stationary until a hit, then move right after landing and recovery.

cases.name: brace
cases.strategy: Hold Shift after observing warning; no movement.

cases.name: dodge
cases.strategy: Move right only after warning is observed; never brace.

cases.name: near-outside
cases.strategy: Remain stationary; pause cases only toggle pause at the observed requested phase.

cases.name: interrupt-warning
cases.strategy: After observing windup, move toward the NPC with a real downward Space dash to interrupt; stop issuing movement once the NPC launches.

cases.name: protection
cases.strategy: Remain stationary for both independently scheduled attacks.

cases.name: boundary
cases.strategy: After landing and recovery, use real left movement to leave the wall.
